scale.0: No explicitness within an otherwise retained contextual label; never a missing value
scale.2: Clearly romantic/sensual but no detailed sexual description
scale.3: Sustained intimate contact or clearly implied activity
scale.4: Direct sexual description with limited anatomical detail
scale.5: Sustained direct description with detailed anatomy or acts

rules: Severity measures narrative explicitness, not moral harm. Record coercion separately.
Null means unassessed; it is never converted to zero.
Coercion, threats, inability to consent and minor involvement require separate context review.
Do not infer consent from marriage, attraction, physiological response, or lack of resistance.
One event is a contiguous encounter or reference within a scene. Multiple acts within that encounter are not arbitrary separate events.
Merge duplicate sources into one event and retain all source IDs. Repeated retellings are distinct dialogue events only when separately narrated.
Sexual-activity reports with unknown original explicitness stay provisional and are not scored.
